source_text: Sed facete ac lepide homo elegantissimus et urbanissimus: "Si dicatur quia castitas infidelium castitas non est; eadem fronte dicetur quia corpus Paganorum corpus non sit, et oculi Paganorum sensum non habeant intuendi, et frumenta quae in Paganorum nascuntur agris, frumenta non sint; et multa alia quae tantae absurditatis sunt, ut risum possint intellegentibus commovere
pass_a_gloss: But facete and lepide human-being elegantissimus and urbanissimus: " if dicatur because chastity unfaithful chastity not is; the-same fronte dicetur because body Paganorum body not may-be, and oculi Paganorum sensum not habeant intuendi, and frumenta which in Paganorum are-born agris, frumenta not may-be; and many-things other which tantae absurditatis are, so-that/as risum possint intellegentibus commovere.
pass_b_english: If someone says that the chastity of unbelievers is not chastity, with the same shamelessness one will say that pagans’ bodies are not bodies, that pagans’ eyes have no power to see, and that grain growing in pagans’ fields is not grain—and many other things so absurd that they can make people who understand laugh.

“The soul and body, and every good thing naturally implanted in soul and body, are God’s gifts even in sinners, since God made these things, not they themselves. But of the things they do it was said: Everything that is not from faith is sin” (Romans 14:23).

choices.why: Julian's forensic/moral fault tied to will, not a substance in nature.

anf_compare.notes: Victorian English of some of Julian survives inside NPNF Augustine (chiefly On Marriage and Concupiscence and related anti-Pelagian books). NPNF was not copied. Pass A is a literal gloss of Augustinus.it Latin of Julian's words only; Augustine's replies in the same locus are excluded. Julian is not first-English.

bible_refs.note: Linked from Julian's wording or a clear allusion in the excerpt.

speaker: Julian of Eclanum (words preserved in Augustine, Contra Iulianum / Against Julian), including authorities Julian quoted; Augustine's reply at this locus is excluded.
